# tenzir_members (Data Source)

The members of an organization and their roles, pending invitations included. Needs `Organization.listMembers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_members" "acme" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
}

output "owners" {
  value = [for m in data.tenzir_members.acme.members : m.email if contains(m.role_ids, "org.owner")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address, if known.
- `id` (String) The member ID, which `tenzir_role_assignment` takes.
- `invitation_label` (String) The label of the member's invitation, if it joined by one.
- `name` (String) The user's name, if known.
- `role_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the assigned roles.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID, unless the member is an invitation nobody redeemed yet.
